name: Character Forge
description: Procedural character creator for the Fracture City world and animated show. Assembles deep identities from the framework (zone, subtype, class, stamp, capture, origin stage) and generates a multi-section backstory + stylized SVG portrait. Can build a character directly from a Coherence Assessment profile.

inputs.description: Optional. Seeds the character's zone, subtype, shape, and stamp from a real assessment profile.

outputs.description: Full character record: identity layers, physical features, mannerisms, backstory paragraphs, portrait SVG, and origin context.

author: Present Palm
